name: Neck Rotation
steps: Sit or stand tall with your shoulders relaxed downward and your chin aligned level over your sternum.
Turn your head slowly to one side until your chin nears the line of your shoulder and you feel a light stretch.
Pause briefly at the end range, then glide smoothly back through center to turn gently toward the opposite side.
Continue alternating calmly from side to side for the target duration before returning to neutral.
tips: Keep your shoulders completely still facing forward so the movement stays strictly at your neck.
Move slowly and gently without forcing your chin past a comfortable, pain-free angle.
